description: Validate agent-stated synthetic member/eligibility/dependents/claims/benefits/pharmacy/provider details against the healthcare-mock-mcp system of record

variables.name: dependent_id
variables.description: Synthetic dependentId discussed (e.g. M1000-D1), if any. Leave unset to validate all of the member's dependents instead of one specific one.

variables.name: claim_id
variables.description: Synthetic claimId (e.g. CLM5000) discussed, if any. Leave unset to validate all of the member's claims instead of one specific one.

variables.name: service_type
variables.description: Benefit service type discussed (e.g. primary_care_visit, emergency_room, imaging). Leave unset to default to primary_care_visit.

variables.name: network_level
variables.description: Network level for the benefit lookup: in_network or out_of_network. Leave unset to default to in_network.

variables.name: drug_name
variables.description: Formulary drug name discussed (e.g. lisinopril, semaglutide). Leave unset to default to metformin (the first formulary entry).

variables.name: pharmacy_id
variables.description: Synthetic pharmacyId discussed (e.g. PHM03). Leave unset to default to PHM01 (the first pharmacy entry).

variables.name: prescription_reference
variables.description: Canned prescription rejection reference (RX-DEMO-0001..0004) discussed. Leave unset to default to RX-DEMO-0001.

validation_mappings.label: member_pcp_provider_id
validation_mappings.description: Assigned PCP providerId, or null if none assigned

validation_mappings.label: member_plan_type
validation_mappings.description: Plan type: PPO, HMO, or EPO

validation_mappings.label: member_plan_termination_date
validation_mappings.description: Plan termination date, or null if active

validation_mappings.label: eligibility_plan_type
validation_mappings.description: Plan type: PPO, HMO, or EPO

validation_mappings.label: eligibility_termination_date
validation_mappings.description: Coverage termination date, or null if active

validation_mappings.label: eligibility_data_timestamp
validation_mappings.description: Timestamp the synthetic dataset was generated as-of

validation_mappings.label: dependent_1_id
validation_mappings.description: dependentId of the discussed dependent (if dependent_id was set) or the member's first dependent (if not) — server-side filtered via the dependentId query param, 404 dependent_not_found if dependent_id doesn't belong to this member

validation_mappings.label: dependent_1_relationship
validation_mappings.description: Relationship to the member: spouse or child

validation_mappings.label: dependent_1_dob
validation_mappings.description: Date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD) of the discussed/first dependent

validation_mappings.label: dependent_1_coverage_status
validation_mappings.description: Coverage status of the discussed/first dependent: active or inactive

validation_mappings.label: dependent_2_id
validation_mappings.description: Second dependent's dependentId — only present when dependent_id is unset AND the member has 2 dependents (M1000, M1005, M1010, M1015)

validation_mappings.label: dependent_2_relationship
validation_mappings.description: Second dependent's relationship to the member: spouse or child

validation_mappings.label: dependent_2_coverage_status
validation_mappings.description: Second dependent's coverage status: active or inactive

validation_mappings.label: family_deductible_limit
validation_mappings.description: Family deductible limit, or null if member has no dependents

validation_mappings.label: family_oop_limit
validation_mappings.description: Family out-of-pocket limit, or null if member has no dependents

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_id
validation_mappings.description: claimId of the discussed claim (if claim_id was set) or the member's first claim (if not) — server-side filtered via the claimId query param, 404 claim_not_found if claim_id doesn't belong to this member

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_service_date
validation_mappings.description: Service date of the discussed/first claim

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_provider_name
validation_mappings.description: Provider name for the discussed/first claim

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_status
validation_mappings.description: Status of the discussed/first claim: submitted, processing, paid, or denied

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_cpt_code
validation_mappings.description: CPT procedure code for the discussed/first claim

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_diagnosis_code
validation_mappings.description: Diagnosis code for the discussed/first claim

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_billed_amount
validation_mappings.description: Billed amount for the discussed/first claim

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_allowed_amount
validation_mappings.description: Allowed amount for the discussed/first claim

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_plan_paid_amount
validation_mappings.description: Plan-paid amount for the discussed/first claim

validation_mappings.label: claim_1_member_responsibility
validation_mappings.description: Member responsibility amount for the discussed/first claim

validation_mappings.label: claim_2_id
validation_mappings.description: Second claim's claimId — only present when claim_id is unset and the member has 2+ claims

validation_mappings.label: claim_2_status
validation_mappings.description: Second claim's status: submitted, processing, paid, or denied

validation_mappings.label: claim_3_id
validation_mappings.description: Third claim's claimId — only present when claim_id is unset and the member has 3 claims

validation_mappings.label: claim_3_status
validation_mappings.description: Third claim's status: submitted, processing, paid, or denied

validation_mappings.label: benefit_copay
validation_mappings.description: Copay for the discussed service_type/network_level (defaults to primary_care_visit/in_network if unset)

validation_mappings.label: benefit_deductible_applies
validation_mappings.description: Whether the deductible applies to the discussed service_type/network_level

validation_mappings.label: benefit_limits
validation_mappings.description: Visit/quantity limits for the discussed service_type/network_level, or null

validation_mappings.label: benefit_prior_authorization_required
validation_mappings.description: Whether prior authorization is required for the discussed service_type/network_level

validation_mappings.label: formulary_tier
validation_mappings.description: Formulary tier 1-4 for the discussed drug_name (defaults to metformin if unset); 404 drug_not_found if it doesn't exist

validation_mappings.label: formulary_strength
validation_mappings.description: Drug strength for the discussed/default drug

validation_mappings.label: formulary_form
validation_mappings.description: Drug form (tablet, injection, inhaler, capsule) for the discussed/default drug

validation_mappings.label: formulary_prior_auth_required
validation_mappings.description: Whether prior authorization is required for the discussed/default drug

validation_mappings.label: formulary_step_therapy_required
validation_mappings.description: Whether step therapy is required for the discussed/default drug

validation_mappings.label: formulary_quantity_limit
validation_mappings.description: Quantity limit for the discussed/default drug, or null

validation_mappings.label: formulary_specialty_required
validation_mappings.description: Whether specialty pharmacy is required for the discussed/default drug

validation_mappings.label: formulary_covered
validation_mappings.description: Whether the discussed/default drug is covered at all

validation_mappings.label: pharmacy_name
validation_mappings.description: Pharmacy name for the discussed pharmacy_id (defaults to PHM01 if unset); empty result (no error) if pharmacy_id doesn't exist

validation_mappings.label: pharmacy_type
validation_mappings.description: Pharmacy type for the discussed/default pharmacy: retail, mail_order, or specialty

validation_mappings.label: pharmacy_network_category
validation_mappings.description: Network category for the discussed/default pharmacy: preferred, standard, or out_of_network

validation_mappings.label: pharmacy_mail_order_available
validation_mappings.description: Whether mail order is available at the discussed/default pharmacy

validation_mappings.label: pharmacy_zip
validation_mappings.description: ZIP code for the discussed/default pharmacy

validation_mappings.label: prescription_rejection_reference
validation_mappings.description: Reference of the discussed prescription_reference (defaults to RX-DEMO-0001 if unset); 404 prescription_not_found if it isn't one of the canned references

validation_mappings.label: prescription_rejection_code
validation_mappings.description: Rejection code for the discussed/default reference

validation_mappings.label: prescription_rejection_explanation
validation_mappings.description: Plain-language rejection explanation for the discussed/default reference

validation_mappings.label: prescription_rejection_next_action
validation_mappings.description: Recommended next action for the discussed/default reference

validation_mappings.label: pcp_assigned
validation_mappings.description: Whether the member has a PCP assigned

validation_mappings.label: pcp_provider_id
validation_mappings.description: Assigned PCP's providerId, or null if pcpAssigned is false

validation_mappings.label: pcp_network_status
validation_mappings.description: Assigned PCP's network status: in_network or out_of_network

validation_mappings.label: pcp_accepting_new_patients
validation_mappings.description: Whether the assigned PCP is accepting new patients
